clue.text: Kitty saved on car use etc going walkabout

definitions.note: a kitty is a cat; one saved from a bad home is a rescued cat

indicators.note: to go walkabout is to wander off, so these letters stray from their places into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's money is saved because they use the car less, and so on, while off wandering in the outback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kitty' looks like a fund of money alongside 'saved', but it is a cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A rescue cat is a feline adopted from a shelter, i.e. a kitty that has been saved.

clue.text: Evidence of gunfire touching ship's side

parts.note: re means concerning or touching on
port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A shot heard as a vessel comes alongside.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is the loud bang of a gun firing, the audible sign that a shot was fired.

clue.text: Revolting Greek supermarket moved custard out of the road

definitions.note: Spartacus led the great slave revolt against Rome; he was Thracian, from the Greek-speaking Balkans

parts.note: Spar is a chain of convenience supermarkets

indicators.note: the remaining letters are moved around into a new order
the letters of the road are taken out of the word custard

parts.note: RD is the usual abbreviation for road

explanation.surface: An unruly Greek man threw custard in a shop and it ended up out on the street.
explanation.walkthrough: RD is the usual abbreviation for road.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartacus was the rebel gladiator who led a slave uprising, so a revolting figure in the sense of rebelling.

clue.text: A bit of alcohol's appropriate for children, silly

parts.note: U is the British film certificate meaning suitable for all ages
a silly, as a noun, is a fool, as is a nit

explanation.surface: A sip of booze is fine for kids, how foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit is the UK measure of alcohol used in drinking guidelines, a small fixed quantity of drink.

clue.text: Battle getting knickers off and on in facilities

explanation.walkthrough: 'Facilities' is a coy word for lavatories here, but the definition means abilities.
explanation.definitionFit: Competences are skills or capabilities, and a facility can be an aptitude or ease in doing something.

clue.text: Glaswegian couple cheers given whiskey to drink

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, as is cheers

explanation.definitionFit: Twa is the Scots form of two, so a pair as spoken in Glasgow.

clue.text: Wealth is of little importance, son

parts.note: mean can describe something lowly or inferior in status

explanation.surface: A moralising remark that riches don't matter, addressed to one's boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone of means has money; the word is used for financial resources or wealth.

clue.text: Measure around the Pope's see, wearing his hat

indicators.note: the hat is worn around the other letters, so they sit inside it

parts.note: a bishop's tall ceremonial headdress is a mitre
c, short for circa, means around
the Pope is Bishop of Rome, so his diocese is Rome

explanation.definitionFit: A micrometre is a millionth of a metre, a unit of length used in measuring.

clue.text: Humble when back in Cambridge collecting degree

indicators.note: the first letters collect the degree inside them

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: the back of a word is its last letter

parts.note: the last letter of the city's name

clue.text: Main item in order, when 'put the kettle on' is insufficient?

definitions.meaning: the headline act on a programme or bill

definitions.text: when 'put the kettle on' is insufficient?
definitions.meaning: read as two words, it is an instruction to get the big tea urn going, for when one kettle will not do

explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads the answer as START URN: a big gathering needs the urn started, not just a kettle.

clue.text: Musician's craft returning from Sinai Peninsula is smuggling

explanation.walkthrough: 'Craft' suggests a vessel smuggling goods; it is the skill of a musician. The letters run from the end of 'from' to the start of 'Peninsula'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pianism is the art or technique of playing the piano, a musician's skill.

clue.text: Domain's extent swollen by a hundred hectares

definitions.note: in biology, a domain is the top rank of classification, and archaea is one domain

indicators.note: the word for extent is made bigger by having these letters put inside it

parts.note: an area is a space or extent
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
ha is the standard symbol for hectares

explanation.surface: Someone's estate grows by a hundred hectares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Domain' looks like landed property, but it is the biologists' highest grouping of living things.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaea are single-celled microorganisms that form one of the three domains of life, beside bacteria and eukaryotes.

clue.text: Orders taken over the phone for hotelier

parts.note: writs are formal orders issued by a court

explanation.definitionFit: César Ritz was the Swiss founder of the famous luxury hotels that bear his surname.

clue.text: Hoover perhaps swallowing brother's geranium

indicators.note: the first name swallows the short form, holding it inside

explanation.definitionFit: Herb Robert is a common wild cranesbill, a species of the geranium genus.

clue.text: Coach Spanish lady to project in part that matters

Inés is a common Spanish woman's name
to project something is to send it out, as a voice or image

clue.text: Barry stripped to change with suit too ratty?

definitions.note: the question mark flags a whimsical sense: like a rat, i.e. a betrayer

explanation.walkthrough: 'Ratty' normally means bad-tempered; here it means behaving like a rat.

clue.text: Cleaner person who complains about leak from 1A?

clue.text: Steamy with dates in bed here?

definitions.text: Steamy with dates in bed here?

parts.words: Steamy with dates in bed here?

clue.text: Grain darkens over good many years

parts.note: dims means makes darker

clue.text: Highlands canal firm's set for engineering

clue.text: The French short cut that's so long

parts.note: terse means short or curt

clue.text: Rob arranges to have two sons twinned

clue.text: Two bridge players getting through £1000 swap partners

clue.text: Which people heading for amber stop?

parts.note: the first letter of amber

clue.text: Record second in list, IMO, is a good example

clue.text: 25 slides to slide around with nobody on them
